title: Attendance history header and KPI cards

Current.dc.html.title: Current - no desktop header, two mismatched divs

OptionA.dc.html.title: A - hero kept, KpiCard for the rest (recommended)

title.text: Attendance History - desktop header + the three summary cards

howto.text: Two asks, one board each change touches. Left: what's there now - no page title on desktop like every /settings page has, and Events/Average are one-off divs that match nothing. Right: two ways to fix both at once. A is the smaller change and the recommendation; B is the alternative if you'd rather all three read as equal peers like Analytics does.

attendanceLive.text: /attendance (the live page) gets the same PageShell header treatment, not mocked separately here - it's the established pattern, not a new design decision. Title "Attendance", no description needed. The event tabs and Refresh button stay exactly where they are in the page body; PageShell's actions slot is for page-level controls, and those are specific to the live session, not the page.
